name: LimX Dynamics TRON 1
summary: A 20 kg two-legged research robot with swappable point feet, soles or wheels for locomotion and reinforcement-learning research; an arm is an optional add-on kit.

germany.statusNote: RobotShop EU sells the TRON1 EDU for 21,636.37 € incl. VAT (on demand) with an add-to-cart button; Bipedal (Leverkusen) offers new units on request and one demo unit for 12,999 € incl. VAT. Muzix (Hungary) also lists it. MegaRobotics (Kaarst) offers the Standard and EDU editions on request.

priceEur.note: TRON1 EDU at RobotShop EU, tax included; Bipedal demo unit 12,999 € incl. VAT.

specs.label: Load capacity
specs.conditions: up to; manual states maximum 15 kg

specs.label: Speed
specs.conditions: wheeled mode; point foot and sole below 1 m/s

specs.label: SDK
specs.value: open SDK, Python, URDF, Isaac/MuJoCo/Gazebo simulation

notes: Two-legged platform without arms or head; no category fits exactly. Arm, sensor and voice kits are optional add-ons.
Wheels are one of three swappable foot modules.
Rated only for favourable weather (-5 to 40 °C); no IP rating.
